name: Renogy
old_description: Renogy is a solar energy product manufacturer based in California. Produces monocrystalline and flexible solar panels, along with charge controllers, battery systems and other solar components for RV, marine and off-grid applications.
about:
Renogy, a solar energy product manufacturer, was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Chino, California. The company employs between 200 and 499 people.

The company produces monocrystalline and flexible solar panels, charge controllers, battery systems, inverters, battery monitors, and DC-DC chargers. Its product line includes the ShadowFlux™ N-Type anti-shading solar panels with 25% efficiency, 12V 300Ah LiFePO4 batteries with low-temperature protection, and pure sine wave inverters delivering over 90% efficiency. Manufacturing scale is reflected in a workforce of up to 499 employees, though facility size and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Renogy serves recreational vehicle (RV), marine, commercial, and off-grid markets, as well as tiny-house and workshop DIY customers. Its solutions are marketed for RV expeditions, tiny-house energy independence, and workshop productivity.

The company emphasizes anti-shading technology, dual alternator-and-solar charging, and high-accuracy battery monitoring as key differentiators for off-grid reliability.
